summary: Reproduced the independent review against candidate ce113fb8d9d5b8a6fac88e0d2364dfcfc7ff2b6b, preserved its valid precision and dispatch fixes, and corrected the named Kimi Linear, Bailing-MoE, Bailing-MoE-Linear, LLaDA2, Bailing-MoE-v3, and DeepSeek-v2 consumers so their router projection policy is inherited from or directly implemented by RouterGate. The candidate remains rejected as a claim of repository-wide consolidation because additional model router implementations have not all been migrated and architecture-qualified.

tests.command: source audit at exact candidate ce113fb8d9d5b8a6fac88e0d2364dfcfc7ff2b6b
tests.what_was_measured: Kimi Linear used ReplicatedLinear; the five named model families declared local nn.Module gates; 60 model files contained ReplicatedLinear instantiations of mixed router and non-router purpose. Raw evidence: raw/candidate_counterexamples.txt
5 RouterGate precision, deterministic-dispatch, compatibility-alias, and checkpoint bias-name tests passed

tests.command: prepared Python import and constructor contract script
tests.what_was_measured: All six affected model modules imported; Bailing, LLaDA2, and DeepSeek adapters are RouterGate instances, preserve checkpoint state-dict names, and return fp32 logits

tests.command: prepared Python MI350X deterministic numerical script
tests.what_was_measured: RouterGate returned fp32, produced exactly equal first-token output at batch sizes 1 and 8 under deterministic policy, and was within 3.814697265625e-06 of an independent CPU fp32 reference
Environment limitation: ruff is not installed in the required prepared interpreter

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X execution recorded in raw/gpu_numerics.txt

remaining_limitations: No model weights were available, so full-model checkpoint loading, serving, semantic accuracy, and performance were not run.
CUDA tiny GEMM, DeepGEMM, HPC-Ops, AMX, NPU, XPU, distributed, NVIDIA, and non-gfx95 paths were unavailable and remain unverified.
DeepSeek-v2 retains a thin RouterGate subclass for its required AMX path and extended forward signature; Bailing and LLaDA2 retain thin subclasses for their expert_bias checkpoint name.

The repository contains additional model-local or ReplicatedLinear router consumers, including generic Mixtral/Qwen/Llama-family paths and architecture-specific gates. The candidate audit did not distinguish all router projections from unrelated replicated projections, and those architectures were not migrated without weights or architecture validation. Repository-wide single-class consolidation therefore remains incomplete.
